message.content: {"issues":[{"number":19,"field":"context","problem":"The Arabic underlined phrase does not preserve the source’s full vowel markings: the source reads «مَمْنُوعُ الْوُقُوفِ», while the transcription omits diacritics including the ḍamma on ن, the sukūn on ل, and the ḍamma on ق."},{"number":22,"field":"context","problem":"Arabic diacritics are incomplete relative to the source, including the missing fatḥa in «جَزَائِرِيٌّ» and the missing ḍamma in «سِيُولَ»."},{"number":23,"field":"options","problem":"Option ⑤ does not preserve the source’s full Arabic spelling/diacritics: the source has «هِوَايَتِي كُرَّةُ السَّلَّةِ», while the transcription omits, among other markings, the shadda on ر in «كُرَّةُ»."},{"number":24,"field":"context","problem":"The shared dialogue is transcribed with the same consequential Arabic-diacritic loss found in question 23; in particular, the source wording corresponding to the hobby statement includes «كُرَّةُ» with a shadda on ر."},{"number":25,"field":"question","problem":"The source underlines «يون سو» in the Korean question stem, but the transcription presents it without underlining."}],"checked_numbers":[19,20,21,22,23,24,25]}
